```yaml
name: Release Testing

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.6, 3.7, 3.8, 3.9, 3.10, 3.11, 3.12, 3.13, 3.14]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -e .
        pip install pytest pytest-cov
        
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        pytest --cov=wove --cov-report=xml
        
    - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
      uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
      with:
        file: ./coverage.xml
        flags: unittests
        name: codecov-umbrella

  test-free-threaded:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.14]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }} free-threaded
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        architecture: x64
        cache: 'pip'
        
    - name: Install free-threaded Python
      run: |
        # Download and install free-threaded Python 3.14
        wget https://github.com/zooba/free-threading-builds/releases/download/3.14.0%2B20240515/python-3.14.0%2B20240515-linux-x86_64.tar.xz
        tar -xf python-3.14.0\+20240515-linux-x86_64.tar.xz
        sudo mv python-3.14.0\+20240515 /usr/local/python-3.14-free-threaded
        sudo ln -sf /usr/local/python-3.14-free-threaded/bin/python3.14 /usr/local/bin/python3.14-ft
        
    - name: Install dependencies with free-threaded Python
      run: |
        /usr/local/bin/python3.14-ft -m pip install --upgrade pip
        /usr/local/bin/python3.14-ft -m pip install -e .
        /usr/local/bin/python3.14-ft -m pip install pytest pytest-cov
        
    - name: Run tests with free-threaded Python
      run: |
        /usr/local/bin/python3.14-ft -m pytest --cov=wove --cov-report=xml
        
    - name: Upload coverage to Codecov (free-threaded)
      uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
      with:
        file: ./coverage.xml
        flags: unittests-ft
        name: codecov-umbrella-ft
```
